Security Stack

Layer Name Description
1 Network Edge Cloudflare Proxy + Cloud Firewalls
2 TLS Termination Caddy auto-HTTPS + Let’s Encrypt
3 Traffic Filtering Rate limiting, bot blocking, scanner blocking
4 Authentication Authelia 2FA (TOTP/WebAuthn) + OIDC bearer tokens
5 Token Validation introspect-proxy OIDC introspection sidecar
6 Network Isolation WireGuard mesh VPN + Docker bridge networks
7 Credential Mgmt Vaultwarden (passwords) + Aegis (TOTP)

Firewall & Ports

Cloud firewall rules and host-level iptables. Only gcp-proxy should accept public traffic. OCI VMs restrict to WireGuard mesh + mail delivery ports.

iptables policy per VM:

VM Chain Rule Purpose
gcp-proxy FORWARD 10.0.0.0/24 → wg0 ACCEPT WireGuard mesh routing
gcp-proxy POSTROUTING 10.0.0.0/24 MASQUERADE NAT for mesh hub
gcp-proxy INPUT 51820/udp ACCEPT WireGuard endpoint
oci-flex-1 INPUT 51820/udp ACCEPT WireGuard endpoint
oci-flex-1 INPUT 22/tcp from 10.0.0.0/24 ACCEPT SSH via mesh only
oci-flex-1 INPUT default DROP (except established) Block public access
oci-mail INPUT 25,465,587,993/tcp ACCEPT Mail delivery (public)
oci-mail INPUT 51820/udp ACCEPT WireGuard endpoint
oci-mail INPUT other DROP (except established) Block non-mail public
oci-analytics INPUT 51820/udp ACCEPT WireGuard endpoint
oci-analytics INPUT 22/tcp from 10.0.0.0/24 ACCEPT SSH via mesh only
oci-analytics INPUT default DROP (except established) Block public access

│                                                            │
